cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Side plates, yes. I've stood this one on its side in the cupboard. It's back for Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Side means small. That one's large, and it's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A small flourish, exactly. I'll take that plate; the potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want six matching plates, not five plain ones and that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more like this before lunch. Keep the plain ones as spares; we needn't sort through those today.
